items.title: HTTP QUERY Method: The Grey Zone Between GET And POST., (Fri, Sep 18th)
items.content: <article>In June 2026 the IETF published RFC 10008[1], defining a new HTTP method: "QUERY". The HTTP protocol faced already by changes (HTTP/2, HTTP/3) but it’s the first new standard HTTP verb since "PATCH" in 2010!</article>

LausivLoader analysis, or how to pass data between malware stages, (Thu, Sep 17th)
items.content: <article>At the end of August, a malspam message was caught in the quarantine of a mail gateway operated by one of my customers. The message was not especially remarkable – it asked the recipient to review some attached requirements and provide a price quotation for a fiber optic system and appeared to impersonate an employee of a legitimate company.</article>

Apple Updates Everything, (Mon, Sep 14th)
items.content: <article>Today, Apple released its annual update across all its operating systems. With that, Apple not only released new features but also patched 261 different vulnerabilities. This is the most vulnerabilities Apple has ever patched, but the increase is not as significant as other vendors' "post-AI" patch releases. </article>
